name: Light Dragon Head

moveOnly.notes: coast.3p.attackFrom = blocked (decision 0020): on a Coast square it captures nothing, gives no check and guards nothing, but still blocks lines.

attackOnly.notes: coast.3p.attackFrom = coast-only (decision 0021, D75.2): on a Coast square it captures and attacks only Coast squares (a King or Queen standing there), and guards only the Coast; it still moves and blocks as usual.

squares.notes: coast.returnAllowed off: a Coast piece that has left the Coast may not come back.
coast.2p.exit = a5-only: a Coast piece leaves the Coast only from A5.
coast.3p.exit = a5-first-then-any: a Coast piece's first way off the Coast is from A5 (decision 0019). Until it has left the Coast once, it neither moves nor attacks off it from another Coast square.
coast.3p.exit = a5-always: a Coast piece leaves the Coast only from A5.

source: Unverified seed (S10, 19 Oct 2026): from docs/RULES.md draft v0.2, ledger decisions D25, D28, D29, D30 and S34, and the owner's board images of 18 and 19 Oct 2026.
notes: The closed Coast (no Coast piece moves, and none gives check, until the Tail opens it: coast.2p.initiation) is game state, not piece data (S17, src/game/game.ts). Ways off the Coast (coast.2p.exit, coast.3p.exit) and capture on the Coast (coast.2p.capturable, coast.3p.capturable) are square rules (S22a; coast.3p.exit reads hasLeft, S68). givesCheck follows the 2-player setting; in 3-player games the game reads dragon.3p.givesCheck and the duel instead (S56, src/game/three.ts, decision 0016).
